newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR RUSSIA V ISRAEL WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR RUSSIA V ISRAEL WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for Sunday's World Cup European group nine qualifying match between Russia and Israel:

Russia - 1-Sergei Ovchinnikov; Yuri Nikiforov, Akhrik Tsveiba, Viktor Onopko, Alexei Kosolapov; Sergei Grishin, Dmitry Alenichev, Vladislav Radimov, Igor Yanovsky; Vladimir Beschastnykh, Dmytry Cheryshev.
Israel - 1-Rafi Cohen; Felix Halfon, David Amsalem, Alon Hazan, Amir Shelah; Arik Bennado, Ronnie Rosenthal, Haim Revivo, Avi Nimni; Eli Ohana, Eyal Berkowitz.
